purpose: Development cross-stratum check on all12 already-published v0.4 scenes, integrated reacquire_grasp. Experimental selected fixed -45deg tool yaw/.10rad exact-grasp IK cap/original carry yaw, no hidden material or scoring input. Full20s native episodes.

acquisition.observations: grip check uses causal current privileged TCP/object pose and bilateral native contacts at 20 ms; no mass/friction or scorer input; downstream original motion policy remains unchanged and uses the existing lift outcome flag
acquisition.qualification: slow 10 mm probe; object rises at least 6 mm, both pads retain contact, support is absent and TCP-local drift <=3 mm for 100 ms
acquisition.alarm: two consecutive snapshots with relative drift, bilateral-contact loss or supported object failing to follow a moving probe; bounded closure/probe timeouts
acquisition.recovery: hold measured six joint targets first; only supported objects may be opened/recentered/retried, at most once; support loss stops closed
acquisition.stop: requested measured joint targets; native rate limiting and inertia may continue motion, which is recorded
acquisition.duration: original fixed episode timeout including every probe/retry/abort holding command
acquisition.scope: authored simulator controller, not a sensor implementation, hardware safety controller or learned policy

prior_contact_contract.observations: causal recorded privileged TCP/object poses and native contact/normal force snapshots; no material, mass, future observation or outcome input to the contact check
prior_contact_contract.history: inclusive past 120 ms of TCP-local object offset; unknown before 100 ms span; displacement is endpoint Euclidean distance, rate is displacement/span, slope is least-squares vector rate, straightness is displacement/summed consecutive path
prior_contact_contract.trend: rate >=25 mm/s, displacement >=2.5 mm and straightness >=0.7 for two snapshots; two bilateral-contact-loss snapshots independently request closed hold
prior_contact_contract.slowdown: scale original requested joint-position delta from measured joints by 0.35 for 120 ms, then hold measured joints closed; actual native speed is measured separately
prior_contact_contract.reassessment: minimum 120 ms hold; known window displacement and maximum pairwise excursion <=1.5 mm and rate <=8 mm/s, loaded bilateral contacts throughout, no table support and object rise >=6 mm sustained for 100 ms; timeout 800 ms, at most two holds
prior_contact_contract.resume: causally refresh original teacher held offset to current TCP-local object offset and scale requested joint deltas by 0.45 until supported arrival; subsequent persistent slip may hold again within the budget
prior_contact_contract.probe_only: identical acquisition and retry; removes postqualification carry monitoring only
prior_contact_contract.stop: measured joint-position requests with jaw closed; inertia and native target rate limits may continue physical motion
prior_contact_contract.duration: unchanged fixed episode budget including probe, retry, slowdown, hold and abort; no force/gain/dynamics/scorer change
prior_contact_contract.scope: authored simulator controller with privileged observations; no learned memory, material inference, sensor latency, hardware safety or task qualification claim

acquisition.observations: grip check uses causal current privileged TCP/object pose and bilateral native contacts at 20 ms; no mass/friction or scorer input; downstream original motion policy remains unchanged and uses the existing lift outcome flag
acquisition.qualification: slow 10 mm probe; object rises at least 6 mm, both pads retain contact, support is absent and TCP-local drift <=3 mm for 100 ms
acquisition.alarm: two consecutive snapshots with relative drift, bilateral-contact loss or supported object failing to follow a moving probe; bounded closure/probe timeouts
acquisition.recovery: hold measured six joint targets first; only supported objects may be opened/recentered/retried, at most once; support loss stops closed
acquisition.stop: requested measured joint targets; native rate limiting and inertia may continue motion, which is recorded
acquisition.duration: original fixed episode timeout including every probe/retry/abort holding command
acquisition.scope: authored simulator controller, not a sensor implementation, hardware safety controller or learned policy

prior_recovery_contract.refusal: full recovery mode only: original two-observation supported object-not-following alarm plus at least 100 ms of bilateral loaded supported contact, closed requests, jaw excursion <=0.5 mm and each pad normal force excursion <=0.05 N; hold closed and refuse the unchanged retry
prior_recovery_contract.refusal_scope: an unchanged grasp did not follow its probe; no mass/friction input or conclusion that a different grasp is impossible
prior_recovery_contract.carry_only: recovery_carry retains exact v0.3 acquisition and supported retry; only carry speed restoration changes
prior_recovery_contract.restoration: after the unchanged v0.3 settling hold, resume at 0.45 joint-delta scale; the same relative settling evidence must persist for 100 ms before scale increases linearly toward 1 over 300 ms of additional stable observed time; pause the increase while evidence is unstable and reset on a new hold
prior_recovery_contract.evidence: known relative history, displacement and maximum excursion <=1.5 mm, rate <=8 mm/s, all samples loaded bilateral and unsupported, object rise >=6 mm; unchanged v0.3 trend/contact-loss responses remain active throughout
prior_recovery_contract.duration: fixed 20-second episode includes refusal holding and every recovery; no force, gain, model, scorer, or instantaneous velocity writes
prior_recovery_contract.scope: authored controller using privileged simulation observations; no learned model, sensor latency, material inference or hardware qualification

reacquisition.eligibility: only an existing postqualification settling hold; unchanged known 100 ms relative history, loaded bilateral unsupported samples, <=1.5 mm displacement/excursion and <=8 mm/s rate; 100 ms low-stable dwell after minimum 120 ms hold; object rise >=1 mm and below original 6 mm resume floor
reacquisition.probe: at most one measured-pose vertical second probe, requested rise <=8 mm at 10 mm/s, fixed measured orientation and closed jaw; 1.2 second total timeout including qualification
reacquisition.failure: close hold and abort on unknown history, any current unloaded or lost pad, renewed table support, unexpected contact, relative offset drift >3 mm, or persistent original slip trend; never increase force or alter gains
reacquisition.resume: second probe measured TCP rise >=4 mm from its origin; unchanged loaded relative settling evidence and original >=6 mm rise sustained 100 ms; refresh measured relative held offset, then original v0.4 reduced delta and restoration; task lift/retention/place gates untouched
reacquisition.scope: authored privileged simulator state, not learned skill, sensor pipeline, calibrated robot or hardware safety control

grasp_strategy.candidate: fixed world-z yaw of the downward grasp orientation; original approach orientation; optionally retain that yaw through postapproach carry poses
grasp_strategy.planner: bounded differential IK; translation error <=15 mm, orientation error <= configured limit only for the exact downward grasp target (original 0.05 rad for approach/carry/measured-pose probes), joint delta <=0.06 rad, damping 0.012, original position/jaw target rates and native control limits
grasp_strategy.unchanged: native gains, force limits, geometry, friction, integration, task scoring and 20-second budget
grasp_strategy.scope: authored fixed development candidate, privileged native state, no material/mass/friction/outcome-based grasp selection and no hardware validation

strategy_contract.selection: fixed before the episode; no hidden mass, friction, outcome, or future observation inputs
strategy_contract.scope: experimental authored simulator candidate; alternate grasp acquisition alone is not completed placement
